task: REAL ENERGY DATA ACQUISITION: DATA ACCESS + TEMPORAL / DEMAND COVERAGE INSPECTION + COMPATIBILITY DECISION

primary_question.question: Can we obtain at least one identified real polar-station electrical demand/load dataset with sufficient temporal resolution, duration, continuity, and measured demand coverage to construct an additive real-data scenario compatible with the existing POLARIS interfaces?
primary_question.answer: The acquisition phase did not establish an openly accessible high-resolution measured polar-station demand dataset.

architecture_boundary.adapter_feasibility_finding: No frozen POLARIS interface incompatibility was identified during acquisition/inspection. Proposed adapter feasibility appears possible subject to obtaining and validating the required high-resolution measurements.

exact_phase_conclusion: The acquisition phase did not establish an openly accessible high-resolution measured polar-station demand dataset. The next project decision is whether to pursue formal access to a restricted measured-demand dataset or, if access is not practical, separately authorize a clearly labeled hybrid real-demand/modelled-system scenario. No adapter implementation is authorized by this phase.

explicit_next_decision_gate.branch_A_formal_restricted_data_access: Pursue formal access to an identified restricted measured-demand dataset, obtain raw data, inspect/validate measurements, reassess compatibility, and only then consider explicit adapter authorization.
explicit_next_decision_gate.branch_B_governed_hybrid_scenario: If formal access is not practical, separately define a hybrid real-demand/modelled-system scenario, explicitly document measured vs modelled quantities, keep clearly labeled as HYBRID, and obtain explicit authorization before implementation.

implementation_authorization_status: RECONNAISSANCE/ACQUISITION COMPLETE — ADAPTER IMPLEMENTATION IS NOT AUTHORIZED.
